NONE: › used to express surprise or confusion, to ask someone to repeat what they have said, or as a way of getting someone to give some type of reaction to a statement that you have made
（表示驚奇或不解，或者請對方重複或作出反應）啊，嗯，甚麽，是嗎，好嗎

example: "Did you hear what I said?" "Eh? Say it again - I wasn't listening."
「你聽見我說甚麽了嗎？」「啊，你再說一遍——我剛才沒在聽。」
Going overseas again, eh? It's a nice life for some!
又要出國，啊？有些人的日子過得真不賴！
